column1: Now suppose that political turmoil causes the country’s risk premium u to rise. Because r 5 r∗  u, the most direct effect is that the domestic interest rate r rises. The higher interest rate, in turn, has two effects. First, the IS∗ curve shifts to the left because the higher interest rate reduces investment. Second, the LM∗ curve shifts to the right because the higher interest rate reduces the demand for money, which in turn implies a higher level of income for any given money supply.
